title: The Storm
text: Every 5 minutes, blue raindrops rise for a 10-second warning. The ensuing 15-second Storm turns them blue-black and ignores walls, roofs and dimensions.
Ranks reset and cannot build; mana regeneration stops and 5% maximum mana drains each second. Once empty, subsequent pulses cost ceil(1% maximum mana) health and can be fatal.
Milk and potion cleansing cannot end the Storm. Logging out pauses its timer; respawning does not reset it. The Cleansing Ritual removes the curse and its timer.
The Star of Fulfillment also clears the Storm and its timer while retaining Arcanist.
